comment: Both banks hold thirty-seven engines (src/draen.cpp:73). Only one sounds at a time; switching fades the current one down and the next up over the menu's fade time, and switching banks does the same. The frequency parameter is -5 to +5 with a display base of 2 from middle C, so the knob covers roughly 8Hz to 8000Hz. The maker names dronecaster, a norns instrument, as the source of the first bank, and the module is a C++ reimplementation of its SuperCollider graphs. The name is Old English for bee, the root of the word drone. The panel prints draen, engine, eng cv, hz, amp, cv, cv, L and R, with a display showing the engine name.
